title: Heat is energy moving because one thing is hotter than another
summary: Heat is energy moving from place to place because of a temperature difference, and it is not the same thing as temperature.
body: OpenStax Physics says it is tempting to say that temperature measures heat, but that is not strictly true. Heat is the transfer of energy due to a temperature difference. People say the heat was unbearable when they mean the temperature was high, because we feel the flow of energy. Heat, like work, transfers energy, and the SI unit named on the page is the joule. How hot or cold something is, as a reading on a scale, is a separate card. Nothing here says how many joules a warm mug holds.
